info.description: Live streaming microservice - supports broadcast (1-to-many) and private (1-to-1) streams, live chat, tipping, and ticketed access.
info.title: Livestream Service API

post.description: Creates a private LOW_LATENCY stream and assigns invited viewer.

get.description: Returns pending private sessions for the viewer.

post.description: Charges session fee and grants playback ticket.
Notifies a viewer about private session invite.

get.summary: List stages created by the caller

post.description: Provisions an IVS Real-Time stage. Use mode=CALL for 1-to-1, mode=BROADCAST for 1-to-many.

delete.description: Only the host can end a stage. All participants are disconnected.

post.description: Returns a short-lived WebRTC token. Pass it to IVSBroadcastClient.Stage on the client.
post.summary: Get a participant token to join a stage

get.description: Returns all broadcast streams by default. Use ?status=live for live-only.

post.description: Creates an IVS channel. Set stream_type to "broadcast" for 1-to-many or "private" for 1-to-1.

get.description: Lists live and past streams for a creator.
Returns stream metadata for the given stream id.

delete.description: Deletes IVS channel and stream metadata.

get.description: Returns whether the requesting user is allowed to watch this stream.
Upgrades HTTP to websocket and subscribes user to stream chat.
Returns recent chat messages for a stream.
Returns IVS ingest endpoint and stream key for OBS/RTMPS broadcasting. Creator only.
Returns real-time IVS channel live state for creator-owned stream.
Returns signed playback URL for viewer after invite/ticket checks.
Returns CloudFront recording URL for a stream.

post.description: Marks stream status as LIVE for creator-triggered broadcast start.
Marks stream status as ENDED for creator-triggered broadcast stop.
Persists stream details (title, status, pricing, ARNs) to the Laravel backend.
Charges viewer and grants stream ticket on success.

get.description: Checks if viewer owns valid stream ticket.

post.description: Charges viewer and emits tip alert event to chat.
Receives stream lifecycle and recording events from IVS.

capabilities.description: Capabilities requested by this participant.  Omit to use mode defaults.

user_id.description: UserID of the participant (resolved from auth when ENABLE_AUTH=true).
